description.narrative: This activity Old Component - To provide United Nations agencies with 26 humanitarian experts through the Standby Partnership Programme is a component of Humanitarian Emergencies Secondment Facility reported by FCDO with a funding type of 105 - Humanitarian assistance and a budget of £1,671,628. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Material relief assistance and services.
